contents.text: This is the booking card. The guest's request comes back as a clear card with the room, the nights, the guests and a way to reach them. It is a card, not a wall of text, so you can see the whole request at a glance.

choices.label: Next: it asks before it sends
choices.why: Nothing leaves the page until the visitor says yes.

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name.

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick it up any time.
